# Accero PrintPortal

> Accero PrintPortal is an independent commercial document processing and printing SaaS platform engineered for cyber cafes, Common Service Centre (CSC) operators, printing shops, and digital service centers across India.

Website: https://printportal.accero.app
Category: Document Processing & Printing Software
Physical Card Standard: ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 (CR80: 85.60 mm × 53.98 mm)

## Core Capabilities
- Alphanumeric Document Lookup with silent multi-provider fallback.
- Manual Data Entry Mode for offline drafting and custom uploads.
- Split-Screen Live Studio with amber missing-field detection.
- Bilingual Regional Typography (Devanagari / Hindi conjuncts via Google Fonts Hind).
- Zero-Margin CSS @page Print Engine for Epson L805/L850, Canon G-series, Zebra, and Evolis PVC trays.
- Transparent pay-as-you-go utility ledger with 100% free lifetime re-printing (₹0).

## Legal & Compliance Disambiguation
Accero PrintPortal is an independent commercial software platform. It is NOT an official government portal, nor is it an NSDL, UTIITSL, UIDAI, Election Commission of India, or RTO partner. The software does not issue statutory credentials or impersonate government agencies. Users must operate in compliance with applicable identity and data privacy regulations.
